beats.visual_prompt: Wide establishing cinematic shot of NH-8, Jharsa stretch in Gurugram-Delhi, wet dark highway asphalt under high-beam yellow headlights, dense highway fog, solitary tree on blind curve, vanishing taillights, cinematic horror photography, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Kaha jaata hai, Gurugram-Delhi ke is NH-8, Jharsa stretch mein sadiyon se aisi taqaton ka dera hai jinka zikr purane dastawezon mein bhi milta hai. Ye wahi jagah hai jahan Woman in white flagging down cars at night. Aaj bhi yahan ke locals kehte hain — din ke ujaale mein sab shant lagta hai, lekin aadhi raat ko is jagah ki hawa badal jaati hai.
beats.sound_cue: Distant wind howl with subtle atmospheric swell

beats.visual_prompt: POV walking shot entering NH-8, Jharsa stretch, dim eerie lantern, deep shadows, atmospheric mist, wet dark highway asphalt under high-beam yellow headlights, dense highway fog, solitary tree on blind curve, vanishing taillights, cinematic horror photography, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Jo log yahan se shaam ke baad guzre hain, unka kehna hai ki jaise hi ghadi mein 12 bajte hain... radio par gaane band hokar ajeeb si static aur kisi ke rone ki dheemi sargoshi aane lagti hai.
beats.sound_cue: Slow approaching footsteps, faint metallic whisper, accelerating pulse

beats.visual_prompt: Tense shaky camera shot at NH-8, Jharsa stretch, sudden sinister shadow moving in darkness, high contrast horror lighting, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Sabse darawani ghatna tab ghati jab raat ke 3 baje car ka engine achanak band ho gaya aur steering wheel apne aap ghoomne laga. Unke paas bhagne ke siva koi rasta nahi bacha tha!
beats.sound_cue: Sudden loud branch snap, aggressive riser, intense rapid heartbeat

beats.visual_prompt: Quiet eerie aftermath shot of NH-8, Jharsa stretch, solitary flickering candle in pitch darkness, cold fog, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Is hadse ke baad se local highway police patrol bhi aadhi raat ko is stretch par akele rukne ki himmat nahi karti. Kuch raaz aise hote hain jinhe band darwazon ke peeche hi rehne dena behtar hai.
beats.sound_cue: Dead silence followed by cold hollow wind
